questions.subject: JAVASCRIPT
questions.learningObjective: Interpret JavaScript behavior demonstrated by a short executable snippet involving arrays — reduce.
questions.explanation: reduce folds every element into the accumulator starting from zero, producing the sum 2111. The initial value is the seed, not an extra element. The printed value is 2111, while the alternatives come from taking only the first element, omitting the last element and starting the accumulator at one.
questions.hint: The accumulator starts at the supplied initial value.
